song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C G Peace of God cover me . D C G cover me, cover me. .G C G Peace of God, cover me, Through the storm, cover me.
[C1] Only in You I am safe Only in You I'm secure Only in You I find peace So Cover me, cover me.
[B1] Cover me when I am hurting Cover me when I'm not strong Cover me when I am going through the storm Cover me when all seems hopeless Cover me when my faith is gone Let the Peace that passes all I understand Cover Me, cover Me.
song.title: Peace of God cover me
